## Limits

- Local time uses clock offsets inferred from the data (Mon–Fri week, no summer time, one offset per country): not verified time zones, and office-hour results on that clock are partly built into the offsets.
- A5 (account-replacement mechanism) and the undocumented CUSTOMER_RECALL label are unresolved and kept as open questions.
- Counts per account depend on the window length (R-BC3); holdouts compare equal windows.
- Quality control: 1 verified exact duplicate row(s); 317 rows with a label outside the appendix. Both are kept and reported.
- Only the organiser CSV is used (see data_compliance_inputs.csv).
